definitions.pass1: mean per-task trial success; not best-of-k
definitions.bothSucceed: all two declared trials succeed; not pass@2
definitions.callsPerSuccessfulTask: all trial calls divided by successful trial count
definitions.physicalCalls: executed authoritative calls after promotions plus speculative executions plus validation DB/tool rereads; excludes native freshness lease checks
definitions.revalidationCalls: physical DB/tool rereads for freshness validation; native snapshot leases perform no such rereads
definitions.freshnessChecks: native Python freshness lease validation calls, counted separately from physical DB/tool rereads; overhead remains included in whole-trial latency
definitions.usefulCalls: verified exact-call speculative reuse, a lower bound on broader usefulness; evidence may influence actor decisions without a matching call
definitions.wastedCalls: speculative executions unused by an exact matching call, an upper bound on waste; this does not establish absence of semantic influence from exposed evidence
definitions.speculationHitRate: verified exact-call reuse divided by physical speculative executions; not a measure of all evidence influence
definitions.billedUsd: legacy field name for provider-reported usage priced at configured standard rates; usage-calculated cost, not invoice-reconciled charges; unknown usage stays unmeasured
definitions.intervals: exploratory percentile 95% family-clustered bootstrap intervals; unadjusted multiple comparisons
definitions.latencyTail: observed sample quantiles, with counts; not stable population-tail guarantees
definitions.latencyMs: native orchestration through termination, before managed-worker drain
definitions.totalTrialSeconds: native orchestration plus acknowledged actor/user managed-work drain
definitions.serviceDrainSeconds: time spent requesting and awaiting both managed-worker closes
definitions.timingSums: sum of overlapping per-trial times, never phase wall time
definitions.physicalReads: transcript-reconciled authoritative read executions plus speculative reads plus physical freshness rereads; excludes mutations and native lease checks
definitions.knownUsageSubtotalUsd: sum of observed usage-priced costs; incomplete lower bound when any trial is unresolved, never invoice reconciled
definitions.declaredTrialAllowanceUsd: original design allowance, not current ledger spent/reserved balance
